info.title: Ticket Service API
info.description:
JSON API of the support ticket management system.

Every error response is a JSON object with an `error` code, in the shape of the `Error` schema. Besides the errors of each operation, any request can get:

- `404` `{"error": "not_found"}` for a path the API does not expose, including a non-numeric id in the URL.
- `405` `{"error": "method_not_allowed"}` for a method the path does not accept; the `Allow` header lists the accepted ones.
- `500` `{"error": "internal_error"}` for an unexpected failure, without internal details.

Listings that support pagination accept the optional `page` and `page_size` query parameters (see the `Page` and `PageSize` parameters). Without either of them the response is the plain array; with at least one of them it is an object `{items, page, page_size, total}`. Pages are numbered from 1, `page` defaults to 1 and `page_size` defaults to 20 with a maximum of 100; a value that is not a positive integer, or a `page_size` above the maximum, is rejected with `400` `validation_error`. A page beyond the last one returns empty `items` with the real `total`. Listings that support search accept `q` (see the `Q` parameter); an empty `q`, or one with only whitespace, behaves as if it was not sent.

200.description: HTML page that renders the contract with Swagger UI.

post.description: Checks the credentials and stores the user in the signed session cookie. Any failure (unknown email, wrong password, inactive user or missing fields) gets the same generic answer.

200.description: Authenticated. The response sets the `session` cookie.

204.description: Session ended. The `session` cookie is cleared.

get.summary: Get the identity of the session user
get.description: Returns the id, name, email and role of the user who owns the session. The UI uses it to learn the role.

post.summary: Change the password of the session user
post.description: Any authenticated user. The format of both fields is checked first (`validation_error`, with `required` for a missing or `null` field and `invalid` for a value that is not text; `new_password` also reports `too_short` under 8 characters), and then `current_password` must match the stored password (`invalid_current_password`, a `400` and never a `401`, so the session stays valid). The new password is stored hashed. The current session keeps working.

400.description: Some fields are missing or invalid (`validation_error`), or the current password is wrong (`invalid_current_password`).

get.description: Admin only. Users of every role, active or not, ordered by name without case and then by id. `q` keeps the users whose name or email contains the text, without case. `is_active` keeps active (`true`) or inactive (`false`) users. `page` and `page_size` are optional: without them the response is an array. The format of every query parameter is validated together (`400`).

post.description: Admin only. Creates an active user with the given role. The email is stored without surrounding spaces and in lowercase, and must not belong to any other user, active or not.

patch.description: Admin only. Changes the name, email or preferred channel of a user. Missing or `null` fields keep their value; any other key (such as `role`, `password` or `is_active`) is ignored. The fields sent are validated like on create.

post.description: Admin only. Logical deletion: the user is marked inactive and kept with all its data and history. An inactive user cannot log in and its email stays reserved. An administrator cannot deactivate itself.

409.description: The administrator tried to deactivate itself (`self_deactivation`).

post.description: Admin only. Reverts a logical deletion: the user is marked active and can log in again with its credentials. Activating a user that is already active is not an error.

post.summary: Reset the password of a user
post.description: Admin only. Sets a new password for any user without asking for the previous one. A missing or `null` `new_password` is `required`, a value that is not text is `invalid` and one under 8 characters is `too_short`. The password is stored hashed.

get.description: Administrator or representative; a client gets `403` before any parameter is looked at. An administrator gets every client, active or not, as `User` objects. A representative gets only the active clients as `ClientSummary` objects (`id` and `name`), and `q` searches the name only; a representative sending `is_active` gets `403` (after the format check). Ordered by name without case and then by id. `page` and `page_size` are optional: without them the response is an array. The format of every query parameter is validated together (`400`).

200.description: Clients as the session user may see them: `User` objects for an administrator, `ClientSummary` objects for a representative; an array or a page object.

403.description: The session user is a client, or a representative sent `is_active` (`forbidden`).

get.description: Admin only. Every user with role `Representative`, active or not, ordered by name without case and then by id. `q`, `is_active`, `page` and `page_size` work as in `GET /users`.

Any authenticated user. Every category, ordered by name without case. `q` keeps the categories whose name contains the text, without case. The list is not paginated: `page` and `page_size` are ignored.

post.description: Admin only. Creates a category (rubro). The name is required, must be text, is stored without surrounding spaces and must be unique without case.

patch.description: Admin only. A missing or `null` name keeps the current one; any other key is ignored. The name is validated like on create; renaming a category to its own name with other case is allowed.

delete.description: Admin only. Physical deletion of a category without product types.

get.summary: List product types grouped by category
get.description: Any authenticated user. Without `category_id`, every category (empty ones included) ordered by name, each with its product types ordered by name. With `category_id`, a list with only that category's group. `q` keeps the product types whose name contains the text, without case, and omits the categories left without matches. The list is not paginated: `page` and `page_size` are ignored.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Positive integer of an existing category. Anything else is `invalid` (`400`).

post.description: Admin only. Creates a product type in an existing category. `name` and `category_id` are validated together (`400`); then the category must exist (`404`) and the name must be free inside it (`409`).

patch.summary: Rename or move a product type
patch.description: Admin only. Missing or `null` fields keep their value; any other key is ignored. The final name must be free in the target category, compared without case.

delete.description: Admin only. Physical deletion of a product type that has no products, active or inactive (`409` otherwise).

get.description: Any authenticated user. Every product, active and inactive, ordered by name without case and then by id. `category_id` and `product_type_id` are optional filters: both are validated together with `is_active`, `page` and `page_size` (`400`), then each must exist (`404`), and the result keeps only the products matching every filter given, `q` and `is_active` included. A product type outside the category gives an empty list. `q` searches the product name. `page` and `page_size` are optional: without them the response is an array.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Positive integer of an existing category; matches the products whose type belongs to it. Anything else is `invalid` (`400`).

parameters.name: product_type_id
parameters.description: Positive integer of an existing product type. Anything else is `invalid` (`400`).

post.description: Admin only. Creates an active product of an existing product type. `name` and `product_type_id` are validated together (`400`); then the product type must exist (`404`) and the name must be free inside it (`409`).

get.summary: List the products available for tickets
get.description: Any authenticated user. Only the active products, ordered by name without case and then by id. `q` searches the product name. `page` and `page_size` are optional: without them the response is an array. Any other query parameter (such as `is_active`, `category_id` or `product_type_id`) is ignored, not rejected.

patch.description: Admin only. Works on active and inactive products and never changes `is_active`. Missing or `null` fields keep their value; any other key is ignored. The final name must be free in the target product type, compared without case.

post.description: Admin only. Logical deletion: the product is kept with `is_active: false` and stays in the tickets that already have it, but it can no longer be added to new tickets. Deactivating an inactive product succeeds without changes.
Admin only. Reverts a logical deletion: the product is marked active and can be added to new tickets again. Activating a product that is already active is not an error.

get.description: The tickets the session user may see: an administrator sees all of them, a client the tickets it owns and a representative the tickets assigned to it. `state`, `client_id`, `representative_id` and `q` narrow the result (all must match); `q` searches the client name and the first message, without case. `client_id` is forbidden to clients and `representative_id` to clients and representatives (`403`, even with their own id). The format of every query parameter is validated together (`400`) before the forbidden filters are checked. Newest first by default (`order`). `page` and `page_size` are optional: without them the response is an array.

post.description: Representatives only: the calling representative becomes the assigned one and the state starts as `New`. `client_id`, `first_message` and `product_ids` are validated together (`400` `validation_error`); then the client must be an active client (`400` `invalid_client`) and every product must exist and be active (`400` `invalid_product`), all or nothing. The first message becomes the first milestone and the products are associated without repeats. Any other key in the body (such as `representative_id` or `state`) is ignored. Admins and clients receive `403`.

400.description: Invalid body (`validation_error`, with `fields`), unknown or inactive client (`invalid_client`) or unknown or inactive product (`invalid_product`).

get.description: The client of the ticket, its assigned representative and admins. Any other user, including another client or representative, gets the same `404` as for a ticket that does not exist or whose id is out of range. Admins read any ticket; a missing one is `404`.

200.description: The ticket, with its participants (id and name) and all its products, deactivated ones included.

post.description: The client of the ticket or its assigned representative. A `New` or `InProgress` ticket becomes `Closed` and the transition is recorded with the user and the time. Closing a closed ticket is `409` `invalid_transition`. A ticket that is not visible to the session user is `404`; admins receive `403`. No request body.

The client of the ticket or its assigned representative; the reopening is direct, with no approval. A `Closed` ticket becomes `InProgress` (never `New`) and keeps the representative that handled it, even if that representative is now inactive. Reopening a ticket that is not closed is `409` `invalid_transition`. A ticket that is not visible to the session user is `404`; admins receive `403`. No request body.

Only the assigned representative; allowed in a `Closed` ticket. Checks run in this order: admin (`403`); body format (`400` `validation_error`, decided without looking up the ticket, so it is the same for an own, foreign or missing ticket); ticket visibility (`404`); assigned representative (`403`, for example the client that owns the ticket); products (`400` `invalid_product` when any is missing or inactive). All or nothing: repeated ids and products already associated are ignored.

200.description: The ticket with all its products.

400.description: Invalid `product_ids` (`validation_error`, with `fields`) or a product that does not exist or is inactive (`invalid_product`).

delete.summary: Remove a product from a ticket
delete.description: Only the assigned representative; allowed in a `Closed` ticket. Only the association is removed: the product stays in the catalog. Checks run in this order: admin (`403`); ticket visibility (`404` `ticket_not_found`); assigned representative (`403`, for example the client that owns the ticket); association (`404` `product_not_in_ticket`, also for a product id that does not exist or is out of range).

post.description: The client of the ticket or its assigned representative. Checks run in this order: body format (`400` `validation_error`, decided without looking up the ticket, so it is the same for an own, foreign or missing ticket); admin (`403`); ticket visibility (`404`); closed ticket (`409` `ticket_closed`). `start_progress` is optional (default `false`) and only has effect when the assigned representative sends it `true` on a `New` ticket, which becomes `InProgress` in the same operation; otherwise it is ignored. The author and the date are those of the session user and the server clock; other keys are ignored.

get.summary: List the milestones of a ticket
get.description: The client of the ticket, its assigned representative and admins, in any state of the ticket. Milestones come in chronological order (oldest first), with their author (id, name and role). Any other user gets the same `404` as for a ticket that does not exist or whose id is out of range. Admins read the milestones of any ticket; a missing one is `404`.

200.description: The milestones of the ticket, oldest first.

sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: Signed Flask session cookie set by `POST /login`.

Forbidden.description: The session user is not an administrator (`forbidden`).

ValidationFailed.description: Some fields are missing or invalid (`validation_error`). `fields` lists every invalid field with its reason.

DuplicateEmail.description: The email already belongs to another user, active or not (`duplicate_email`).

UserList.description: Users ordered by name without case, then by id, each with its role and state. A plain array, or a page object when `page` or `page_size` was sent.

DuplicateCategory.description: Another category already has this name, compared without case (`duplicate_category`).

CategoryInUse.description: The category still has product types and cannot be deleted (`category_in_use`).

DuplicateProductType.description: The category already has a product type with this name, compared without case (`duplicate_product_type`).

ProductTypeOrCategoryNotFound.description: No product type has this id (`product_type_not_found`), or the target category does not exist (`category_not_found`).

ProductTypeNotFound.description: No product type has this id (`product_type_not_found`).

DuplicateProduct.description: Another product of the product type, active or inactive, already has this name without case (`duplicate_product`).

ProductList.description: Products ordered by name without case, as an array or, when `page` or `page_size` is sent, as a page object.

CategoryOrProductTypeNotFound.description: The `category_id` filter names no category (`category_not_found`), or the `product_type_id` filter names no product type (`product_type_not_found`).

ProductOrProductTypeNotFound.description: No product has this id (`product_not_found`), or the target product type does not exist (`product_type_not_found`).

ProductTypeInUse.description: The product type has products, active or inactive, and cannot be deleted (`product_type_in_use`).

TicketForbidden.description: The session user may not perform this operation on tickets (`forbidden`): an administrator on any write operation, a forbidden listing filter (`client_id` for clients, `representative_id` for clients and representatives), a non-representative creating a ticket, or a user who is not allowed to act on the ticket (for example a client changing its products).

TicketNotFound.description: No ticket with this id is visible to the session user (`ticket_not_found`). The same response is returned for a missing, out-of-range or foreign ticket.

ProductNotInTicket.description: The ticket has no association with this product, or the ticket is not visible to the session user (`product_not_in_ticket` or `ticket_not_found`).

InvalidTransition.description: The ticket state does not allow this transition (`invalid_transition`).

InvalidClient.description: The client does not exist, is inactive or is not a client (`invalid_client`).

InvalidProduct.description: A product does not exist or is inactive (`invalid_product`); nothing is associated.

TicketClosed.description: The ticket is closed and accepts no more milestones (`ticket_closed`).

TicketList.description: The tickets ordered by creation date and, for the same instant, by id in the same direction. A plain array, or a page object when `page` or `page_size` was sent.

email.description: Compared without surrounding spaces and case-insensitively.

User.description: A user as returned by the API. It never includes the password or its hash.

fields.description: Invalid field name mapped to its reason.

name.description: Category name. Stored without surrounding spaces; unique without case.
New name. Missing or `null` keeps the current one.
Stored without surrounding spaces; unique without case inside its category.

category_id.description: Positive integer of an existing category. Anything else is `invalid`.

name.description: New name. Missing or `null` keeps the current one.

category_id.description: Category to move the type to. Missing or `null` keeps the current one; anything but a positive integer is `invalid`.

is_active.description: `false` once deactivated; an inactive product cannot be added to new tickets.

name.description: Stored without surrounding spaces; unique without case inside its product type, inactive products included.

product_type_id.description: Positive integer of an existing product type. Anything else is `invalid`.

name.description: New name. Missing or `null` keeps the current one.

product_type_id.description: Product type to move the product to. Missing or `null` keeps the current one; anything but a positive integer is `invalid`.

TicketParty.description: Name and id of a ticket participant. The email is never exposed.

products.description: Associated products; deactivated ones are still listed (`is_active: false`).

client_id.description: Positive integer of an active client. Missing or `null` is `required`; anything else invalid is `invalid`.

product_ids.description: Optional ids of active products to associate.
Ids of active products to associate. Missing, `null`, empty or malformed is `validation_error`.

MilestoneAuthor.description: Author of a milestone. No email.

Milestone.description: Immutable entry of a ticket's timeline.

start_progress.description: When true on a `New` ticket, moves it to `In Progress`. Optional, defaults to false.

ClientSummary.description: The minimal view of a client that a representative gets: no email, channel or state.

current_password.description: The password the session user has now.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1 when `page_size` is sent. Sending `page` or `page_size` turns the response into a page object.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Items per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20 when `page` is sent. Sending `page` or `page_size` turns the response into a page object.

Q.name: q
Q.description: Search text. Empty or whitespace-only text behaves as if `q` was not sent.

IsActive.name: is_active
IsActive.description: Filter by state: `true` keeps active records, `false` keeps inactive ones. Any other value, including an empty one or a different case, is rejected with `400`.

TicketState.name: state
TicketState.description: Keep the tickets in this state. Only the exact values are accepted; any other, including an empty one or a different case, is rejected with `400`.

TicketClientId.name: client_id
TicketClientId.description: Keep the tickets of this client. A positive integer, otherwise `400`. Administrators and representatives only; a client sending it gets `403` (after the format check).

TicketRepresentativeId.name: representative_id
TicketRepresentativeId.description: Keep the tickets assigned to this representative. A positive integer, otherwise `400`. Administrators only; clients and representatives sending it get `403` (after the format check), even with their own id.

TicketOrder.name: order
TicketOrder.description: Creation order: `desc` (default, newest first) or `asc` (oldest first). Any other value is rejected with `400`.
